verdict.rationale: Expensify offers corporate cards with Smart Limits and supports importing existing card programs, implying spend-limit controls, but the evidence emphasizes BYOC (bring your own cards) rather than instantly issuing new physical/virtual cards, and there's no documentation of an actual 'minutes to issue' workflow or virtual card issuance process. missing for 10: concrete documentation of issuing new physical/virtual cards in minutes, virtual card issuance flow, per-card limit-setting UI, and independent confirmation of speed/ease of issuance.
